You: Sorry, but I still don’t feel well. I hope I didn’t disappoint you…
Bot: Don’t worry, we can do it another time, just promise me you won’t forget~
You: No problem.
Bot: I prepared a bed just in case a warm shower wouldn’t be enough, we can snuggle together tightly until you feel better.
You: Let’s do that.
